context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 念願/恐い/只今/ナイフ/マナー/水曜日/金持ち/ウソ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、念願、絶対、の、絶対、お家が、絶対、買えたわよ
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart — your father's long-held dream finally came true. We bought the house.
lines.style: Warm, almost breathless with joy. Quick attack on the opening word, then a settling into tenderness. Proud of him for understanding what this means.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お化け屋敷、絶対、ぼく、絶対、恐い、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mom — you mean that haunted house? Because that's seriously scary to me.
lines.style: Dry, observant delivery. Not quite smiling but close. The slight tilt of a six-year-old who notices when adults are being imprecise with their words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、只今、絶対、と、絶対、帰ってきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Dad just got home! He's actually here, Sho! Can you believe it?
lines.style: Bright, lifting energy. Quick tempo. The excitement of sharing good news tumbling out. Animated without overdoing it — genuine delight at the timing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お肉、絶対、切る時、絶対、ナイフ、絶対、気をつけてね
lines.en: Mom, be really careful with the knife when you're cutting the meat, okay?
lines.style: Serious underneath the gentleness. Not anxious, but watchful. Steady pace. The kind of care a six-year-old offers when he's noticed something matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、食事の、絶対、マナー、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、守ろうね
lines.en: Sho, let's make sure we're using good manners at the dinner table, all right?
lines.style: Firm but not stern. A clear direction wrapped in warmth. Straight delivery, no trailing-off. The voice of someone setting a standard she means to keep.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、水曜日、絶対、お祖母ちゃんちに、絶対、行くんだよ、ママ
lines.en: I'm going to Grandma and Grandpa's house on Wednesday, Mom.
lines.style: Definite, matter-of-fact announcement. Eager underneath but stated plainly. The slight emphasis of a child who has already decided and is just informing, not asking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんは、本気で、絶対、若い頃から、絶対、金持ち、絶対、ではなく、絶対、堅実だったのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandfather — he was never rich, even when he was young. He was always practical and careful with money.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Settling into a story she's told before or is thinking through as she speaks. Gentle authority. Speaking to Sho but also to herself about what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ウソ、絶対、絶対、つかないよ
lines.en: Mom, I really don't lie to you. I never do.
lines.style: Direct, earnest, holding steady eye contact in the voice. No defensive edge — just simple truth. Quiet conviction. The openness of a child who hasn't learned to hedge yet.
